purpose: Document draft dynamic strategy hypotheses and their hard freeze/data gates. It names no product, sets no asset-class quota or cash target, and authorizes no action.
open_universe_rule: Every qualifying onshore public instrument may be considered under a frozen point-in-time rule. A formal test still needs a finite PIT member set at every decision date; this is not a fixed asset list or retrospective selection.

objective.definition: Every predeclared complete rolling five-year OOS window has annualised net TWRR of at least 5%.

pre_registration_status.hard_rule: No hypothesis may be labelled pre-registered or executable until all frozen_fields and all admission gates pass.

common_frozen_fields_required: exact field names, sources, units and transformations
winsorisation, standardisation, invalid-value and missing-data rules
universe filters, thresholds and stable tie-breakers
information lags and venue decision/session calendars
exact start/end dates, non-overlapping OOS cohorts and rolling-window endpoints
dated proportional cost and tax convention
PIT source manifest, archive IDs, as_of and available_at

common_controls.return_basis: Raw prices plus complete event ledger, or one verified total-return series. Never add a receipt to an adjusted/total-return series.
common_controls.mapping_status: The companion artifact is a draft test-only strategy mapping: it maps members to unitized weights and residuals but is not authorised, source-tested or independently approved.
common_controls.no_fill_rule: Missing data, halt, limit lock, settlement restriction, participation shortfall or unsupported action creates explicit no-fill/partial-fill state; no synthetic fill or automatic substitute.
common_controls.scale_neutrality: Formal replay needs unitized mapping and proportional dated costs; lots, minimum commissions and holder-specific tax are not substitutes.
common_controls.B0_B1_rule: Freeze B0/B1 with identical valuation dates, receipt treatment, cost convention and PIT eligibility evidence.

receipt_state_rule.credit_rule: Credit net amount once to an internal marked receipt state on actual payment/settlement timestamp.
receipt_state_rule.through_tested_oos_cohort: Mark at nominal value through the tested OOS cohort, with no assumed interim return or automatic reinvestment.
receipt_state_rule.later_scheduled_decision: The draft mapping does not reassign the receipt state. A different treatment requires a new frozen rulebook revision before testing.
receipt_state_rule.external_flow_boundary: External withdrawal is outside this test design and requires a separately documented TWRR subperiod break.

hypotheses.concept_not_evidence: Liquid A-share QVIM membership may differ from a passive eligible-universe comparator after cost; no factor premium or target attainment is asserted.
hypotheses.draft_lag_and_membership: Financial input no earlier than first official session after full public timestamp plus one session; market input ends prior close. When frozen, membership requires QVIM > 0 and top-decile cutoff, with stable PIT security-ID ascending ties.
hypotheses.mapping_consistency: H1 membership QVIM > 0 is required before mapping score QVIM/sigma_63 is calculated; no non-positive-QVIM member reaches mapping.
current_q0_reason: no R1/R2 or independent risk approval

hypotheses.concept_not_evidence: Timestamped public earnings information may differ from a passive event comparator after cost; consensus availability, drift and exit price are not assumed.
hypotheses.draft_lag_and_membership: Use only latest consensus demonstrably available strictly before full publication time; no target before next permitted official session. When frozen, membership requires positive_surprise > 0 and top-decile within a fully defined batch, with stable announcement-ID ascending ties.
current_q0_reason: no R1/R2 or independent risk approval

hypotheses.scope_change_rule: Any added instrument class requires a new authorised data contract and frozen rulebook revision.
hypotheses.concept_not_evidence: Total-return trend across only the stated classes may differ from a passive eligible-universe comparator after cost; no predictive claim or class quota is made.
draft_inputs: raw price plus events or verified total-return series
hypotheses.draft_lag_and_membership: Inputs end at prior official close; only events available at cut-off are usable. When frozen, membership requires strictly positive signal, full valid lookback and stable security-ID ascending ties where ranking is needed.
current_q0_reason: no R1/R2 or independent risk approval

lookthrough_missing_rule: Missing required look-through field means ineligible, not independent.
formal_admission: authorised and independently approved draft mapping
current_state: q=0 until every admission gate passes
